verdict: No current production deposition kernel samples meteorology. Both kernels consume externally supplied process coefficients on the canonical #76/#171 particle transaction; there is no legacy deposition meteorology sampling path to retire. Deriving those coefficients from canonical meteorology is new deposition physics owned by #33/#36 and, for particle-scale precipitation, needs the new #227 capability.
